**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject invalid target moduli in `try_build`**

When a caller supplies a non-positive target modulus, this supposedly fully fallible constructor still delegates directly to `try_new`: `basis_b = [0]` panics in `modd` during table construction, while a negative target modulus is accepted and produces an invalid map. This is reachable through the new public API with inputs such as `try_build(&[2, 3], &[0])`, so validate `basis_b` and return a typed basis error before constructing the map.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve panic isolation around NTT construction**

The `--moduli` parser accepts arbitrary `u64` values, but `NTTEngine::try_new` is not panic-free for all of them—for example, modulus `1` passes its divisibility check and then triggers `MontgomeryContext::new`'s `q > 1` assertion, while modulus `0` can underflow in debug builds. Replacing `catch_unwind` with this direct call therefore makes the entire probe abort instead of emitting the intended `REJECTED_CONFIGURATION` record for malformed candidates.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Restore ignores for generated repository outputs**

Replacing the existing ignore file with only `target/` exposes generated outputs that repository tooling still creates, including `scripts/__pycache__/`, `bench-results/`, `bench-archive/`, Lean `.lake/` directories, and Coq build files. For example, simply running `python3 scripts/test_cram_compare_results.py` now leaves `scripts/__pycache__/` in `git status`, and benchmark/proof workflows can leave much larger artifacts available for accidental commits; retain the prior generated-artifact rules alongside this Rust target rule.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Do not advertise an unusable release profile**

When `--cargo-profile release` is selected, the runner builds the probe with only the `serde` feature, but the probe always uses a seeded `ShadowHarvester` and its key-generation path calls `require_secure_rng`, which panics in release builds without `allow_insecure`. Enabling that feature is not an alternative because the crate has a release-mode `compile_error!` for it, so every advertised release-profile matrix run aborts before producing result JSON; restrict this option to debug or provide a release-compatible RNG path.
